verdict.rationale: PII scrubbing is a fair question for an error-tracking platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents neither server-side scrubbing rules nor SDK-level parameter filtering. The security doc covers only an outbound Honeybadger-Token header, and the JS changelog mentions generic event-context options; neither concerns redacting sensitive data.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can scrub PII from error events — server-side scrubbing rules plus SDK-level filtering — before sensitive payloads ever persist
